additionalAdversarialFindings.finding: The card unstarves annual_upgrade but property_unlock stays starved on this surface, and it is in SETTINGS_RUNNABLE, so it looks live and is not.
additionalAdversarialFindings.disposition: DECLARED, not fixed. The free-message counters live inside the response's per-PROPERTY block, so an account-level read has none; freeMessagesLeft is null and the rung is suppressed. That is nextAction.ts's own documented contract. Reported in the close as a remaining starved rung with its reason, rather than being papered over by feeding it a count from somewhere else.

additionalAdversarialFindings.finding: The mount's stale prose asserted a starvation that no longer holds: the Plan hero said 'Tier name and billing interval are not on that wire' and nextAction.ts said the annual rung was 'STARVED TODAY, DELIBERATELY'. A comment asserting a dead mechanism is the same defect class as a dormant control.
additionalAdversarialFindings.disposition: Both corrected in the same change. The nextAction.ts diff is COMMENT-ONLY and that was proved mechanically: git diff filtered to non-comment added/removed lines is empty.
